priorityList: --- Icy Veins Rotation (Priority List) ---
Use Outbreak when not running Blightburst.
Use 2x Festering Strike.
Use Army of the Dead + Dark Transformation + Trinket + Racial + Potion
Use Soul Reaper.
Use Outbreak to maintain your plagues on the target.
Use Festering Scythe if its debuff has fallen off.
Use Soul Reaper if the enemy is below 35% health or you have triggered the Reaping effect from Dark Transformation.
Use Death Coil when you have a Sudden Doom proc or 80+ Runic Power.
Use Death Coil.
Use Outbreak.
Use Soul Reaper if any enemy is below 35% health or you have triggered the Reaping effect from Dark Transformation.
Use Epidemic when you have 80+ Runic Power or a Sudden Doom proc. Use Death Coil when fighting less than 3 targets (5 targets during Forbidden Knowledge).
Use Epidemic. Use Death Coil when fighting less than 3 targets (5 targets during Forbidden Knowledge).
--- WoWhead Rider of the Apocalypse Opener ---
Cast Outbreak.
Cast Army of the Dead.
Cast Dark Transformation
Use On-Use Trinket.
Use Combat Potion.
Cast Soul Reaper.
--- WoWhead Rider of the Apocalypse Rotation ---
Cast Outbreak if Virulent Plague is not active.
Cast Army of the Dead on cooldown.
Cast Dark Transformation on cooldown.
Cast Festering Scythe if any target doesn't have its debuff, or its debuff is about to expire.
Cast Epidemic.
Cast Festering Scythe if any target doesn't have its debuff, or its debuff is about to expire.
